response.body: The controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels shall be provided and maintained for work covered by this safety alert. This clause applies to activities archived under CONTAINMENT-OF-HYDROCARBONS at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility.
